name: Finance & Accounting
description: A CV-first layout for finance and accounting professionals: experience and qualifications lead the menu, with headline figures and selected engagements that show the numbers.
guidance: Only publish figures, employer names and client names you are allowed to share. Never publish confidential financial data, such as unreleased results, client accounts, payroll or tax records, and check your employer and client agreements before naming anyone.

heroSuggestions.title: Finance and Accounting Manager
heroSuggestions.summary: Finance and accounting professional focused on accurate reporting, strong controls and forecasts the business can act on, with a record of faster closes and clean audits.

seo.title: {name} — {title}
seo.description: {name}, {title}. Experience, qualifications and selected engagements with measured results.
seo.aboutDescription: About {name}, {title}: the experience, qualifications and approach behind the numbers.

summary.hint: The scope of the role: the team, the entities or the reporting you were responsible for.

highlights.label: Key results
highlights.hint: One per line, up to 12. Lead with the figure, such as days saved or accuracy reached.

title.hint: Name the engagement, for example the process or project and the kind of organisation.

role.hint: Your part, for example Finance lead or Project accountant.

org.label: Entity or client
org.hint: The business entity or client the work was for. Shown on the card and in the strip on the home page. Only name an entity, employer or client you have permission to name.

problem.label: The situation
problem.hint: The problem or requirement and what was at stake. Plain text.

approach.label: What I did
approach.hint: The work, the controls or methods used and how you checked it. Plain text. Never include confidential financial data.

impact.label: Results
impact.hint: One result per line, up to 8. Start with the figure, such as "44% shorter close", so it is shown large; the first line is shown on the card. Use figures you can share.

heroImage.label: Cover image
heroImage.hint: Shown on the engagements grid and at the top of the engagement page. JPEG, PNG or WebP. Cropped to a wide, shallow card.

screenshots.label: Supporting images
screenshots.hint: Add pictures one at a time on the Images page, such as a chart or a process diagram. Remove confidential figures first. Each needs a description for people who cannot see it.

links.label: Links
links.hint: Where to see more, such as a published report or article. Videos are linked, never embedded.

category.hint: An area such as Reporting, FP&A or Audit and controls. Used by the filter on the engagements page.

credentialUrl.label: Link to the register entry or certificate

url.label: Link to the recording or slides
url.hint: http or https. Recordings are linked, not embedded.

quote.label: What they said
quote.hint: Plain text. Only with the person's permission.

body.label: Note text
body.hint: Markdown. Raw HTML is shown as text, not run.

cover.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP. Shown at the top of the post and when it is shared.

heading.label: Home page introduction
heading.hint: The first thing visitors read, above your headline figures. Plain text. Changes apply as soon as you save.

eyebrow.label: Role line
eyebrow.hint: For example your profession, sector and specialism. Plain text.

heading.label: Headline figures
heading.hint: The big numbers at the top of your home page, such as days to close, forecast accuracy or savings found. Only publish figures you can share. Changes apply as soon as you save.

unit.hint: For example days or per year.

heading.label: Pages of your site
heading.hint: Choose which pages the site has, what the menu calls them and in which order. Hiding a page never deletes it. Changes apply as soon as you save.

heading.label: About you
heading.hint: Your story, how you work and what you care about. Changes apply as soon as you save.

valueProps.label: Principles
valueProps.hint: Short statements about how you work, shown above the text.

heading.label: Back up and restore your portfolio
heading.hint: Keep your portfolio in one file, or restore one. You see what would change first, and nothing is ever removed.

exportHeading.label: Save a copy
exportHeading.hint: One file with your details and every entry, including unpublished ones. Pictures you uploaded are listed, not included.

importHeading.label: Restore from a file
importHeading.hint: Each entry in the file is matched to one of yours by its name or title: a match is updated, anything else is added.

layout.footerNote: Finance and accounting portfolio. Figures and clients are shared with permission.

home.workHeading: Engagements and the numbers behind them
home.workEmptyBody: Add the engagements you are proudest of. Lead with the result, then explain the situation and what you did.
home.contactHeading: Need a steady pair of hands? Let us talk.

projects.title: Engagements
projects.description: Selected engagements, each with the situation, what was done and the measured result.
projects.heading: Engagements and results
projects.lead: Each engagement leads with the outcome: the situation, what I did and what it was worth to the business.
projects.emptyBody: Add your first engagement with the situation, what you did and the result it delivered.
projects.noWriteup: The full account of this engagement is on the way.

experience.title: Experience
experience.description: {name}'s finance and accounting experience: roles, scope and results, most recent first.
experience.heading: Where I have worked
experience.lead: Most recent first: the role, the scope of the work and the results that followed.
experience.empty: No roles have been added yet.

skills.title: Skills & systems
skills.description: Finance and accounting skills grouped by area: reporting and close, FP&A, audit and controls, tax and compliance, systems.
skills.heading: What I work with
skills.lead: Grouped by area: the methods, standards and systems I rely on.
skills.empty: No skills have been added yet.

certifications.title: Qualifications
certifications.description: Professional qualifications and memberships: held, in progress and planned.
certifications.heading: Qualifications & memberships
certifications.lead: Professional qualifications, memberships and the study that keeps them current.
certifications.emptyBody: Add the qualifications or memberships you would like to show.

blog.title: Notes
blog.description: Notes on reporting, controls and planning.
blog.heading: Notes on finance
blog.lead: What I am learning about reporting, controls and forecasting.

talks.heading: Talks & workshops
